engram.description: Optional memory integration. New native runs use Engram after validated project/session bootstrap; omission means complete local task storage. Configured failures block without fallback. Setup may install only with explicit consent; runtime never installs or upgrades.

endpoint.description: Runtime additionally checks that the explicit port is at most 65535.

project.description: Legacy field ignored by native runtime with a migration notice. The provider resolves each actual workspace independently.

binary.description: Absolute path to an already installed, approved Engram executable. Runtime validates absolute paths.

dataDirectory.description: Absolute managed memory directory, normally the global OpenCode mdd/memory directory; records are bound to provider-resolved workspace identities.

knowledge.description: Optional canonical Engram observations and explicit per-checkout mdd/knowledge.json approved skill catalog. Defaults on when omitted; explicit false disables it. Does not configure Engram or create a catalog. Freshness validates declared bytes, not truth or authority. Child-only excerpts and observations share three entries/8 KiB; delivery metrics use existing telemetry opt-out. Catalogs never grant tools or permissions.

workers.description: Global parallel-worker preference, default on when omitted. Captured at startup; dispatch remains sequential until batch execution is supported.

verify.description: Automatic correction after a failed Verify, automatic mode only. Each pass corrects every implementation finding in Apply, then Verify rechecks only those findings; a second pass runs only when the first recheck closed findings and opened none. Design or requirement causes and interactive mode always stop for the user. 0 keeps every failed Verify waiting for the user. Defaults to 2 when omitted.

name.description: Runtime also rejects prototype names and case-insensitive Windows device names. Active profile must exist.

model.description: provider/model, optionally with a nested model path and a trailing #variant reasoning-effort suffix (e.g. provider/model#high).

artifactStore.description: Retained legacy data; ignored for automatic new native-run backend resolution. Restored runs keep their frozen backend.
